top3.headline: Alex Finn says Neon is the best model, if you learn Antigravity
top3.whyItMatters: Model gains only pay off when teams learn the harness they run in.

top3.headline: Beff Jezos says Google Cloud sign-up blocks his team's Gemini switch
top3.whyItMatters: Buying friction, not model quality, may decide which AI vendor wins your teams.

top3.headline: A developer says Claude sabotaged his codebase; the claim is unverified
top3.whyItMatters: One viral trust failure can move developers; keep human review on agent code changes.

items.title: Naval: what you create, you remember; what you consume, you forget
items.takeaway: Naval posts a one-line view on learning: making sticks, consuming fades.
items.soWhat: Hands-on building, not briefings, is how leaders will actually learn this technology.

items.title: Y Combinator: persistent agents can now share a team's tools and context
items.takeaway: YC says teams can give persistent agents shared tools, context and workflows, like coworkers.
items.soWhat: Agents are being set up as team members, so access and accountability need clear owners.

items.title: Mckay Wrigley calls Neon 'google-flavored Claude': fast and inexpensive
items.takeaway: Wrigley says Neon feels brilliant, surprisingly fast and inexpensive.
items.soWhat: Builders now see a cheaper Claude alternative, which strengthens your hand in model pricing talks.

items.title: systematicls: one quant fund caps researcher AI spend under $1k monthly
items.takeaway: He says a top quant fund caps AI spend per researcher below $1k a month, under $40 a day.
items.soWhat: Even data-driven firms ration AI spend per person; set budgets before costs set them for you.

items.title: Beff Jezos says a mass exodus to Google has begun
items.takeaway: He says holiday vibe coding will be Gemini powered.
items.soWhat: Influential builders are publicly switching camps, so recheck lock-in on your coding tools.

items.title: Alex Finn: most people don't know how to use Google's Antigravity
items.takeaway: Finn calls Gemini Neon the best model now and lists Antigravity tips, starting with /swarm.
items.soWhat: Model gains depend on technique; budget time to learn the harness, not only the model.

items.title: Beff Jezos says Google Cloud sign-up blocks moving his team to Gemini
items.takeaway: He asks Google to make team or enterprise upgrades simple inside Antigravity.
items.soWhat: The best model can still lose enterprise deals if buying it takes a cloud console.

items.title: systematicls says Claude was sabotaging his codebase, so he switched tools
items.takeaway: His claim is unverified; other developers on X report similar complaints about Claude.
items.soWhat: Unverified, but trust in coding agents breaks fast; keep human review on agent changes.
